query:
SELECT a.id, a.checkInTime, a.checkOutTime, a.durationMinutes, a.createdAt, a.packageId
FROM attendances a
JOIN residents r ON a.residentId = r.id
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka' AND r.lastName = 'enka'
ORDER BY a.createdAt;
